'''Charflutter''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Firecoil]] at 18 stars and into [[Chrysolaria]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Beauty can be deceiving, but Charflutter's 'hotness' is undeniable. Especially when blasting off Zobos to protect fellow Tatari."

Charflutter is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Charflutter's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Chrysolaria]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* In [[Island Gold Rush]] use 20,000 energy drinks.
* Own 24-star Fire Tatari x3.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Charflutter's got lots of friends. Flying in the woods at night, there's always a flock of moths following."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Known to dance with Waveflutters, during which their touching scales can make the air shimmer with light."
